name: Taking Care Of The Pastor
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of pastors as overseers appointed by the Holy Spirit to shepherd the church, which Christ purchased with His own blood (Acts 20:28; Ephesians 4:11). Believers are called to support and care for their pastors, recognizing that the laborer deserves his wages and that those taught in the Word should share all good things with their teachers (Luke 10:7; Galatians 6:6). Additionally, the congregation is urged to obey and submit to their leaders, who watch over their souls with accountability before God, so that their ministry may be carried out with joy rather than grief (Hebrews 13:17). Finally, the solemn responsibility of teaching is underscored by the warning that those who become teachers will face stricter judgment (James 3:1).
